subject: Pointer packing 3a; native_ai path ack
body:
Ack rtl/native_ai/loader (not native_graph). Architecture contract [§02.9] updated:

Canonical semantic refs stay 32-bit.
Internal physical pointers MAY be narrower than 32 bits only if all of: not identity; lossless; explicit boundary conversion; you show resource/timing benefit.
Do not publish 28-bit as identity or as §04 wire ABI.

MIG app_data still UNKNOWN until generated IP is read.
In-record NCG CRC16 polynomial is implementation-defined; wire Query/Result CRC is B [§04.12] CRC16-CCITT-FALSE.

ManifestHeader 128 vs 132 remains B. Your reserved=12 M1 layout is CANDIDATE until B confirms.
